name: Slite
description: Slite is an AI-powered knowledge base that monitors connected tools to detect outdated documentation and suggests updates, aiming to keep docs accurate as a "single source of truth."
best_for: Organizations (the site cites "3,000+ leading companies") across IT & Operations, Product & Engineering, Customer Support, and HR, including teams migrating from Notion, Confluence, or ClickUp.
features: Slite Agent that monitors integrated tools (Slack, Linear, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, Asana, etc.) for changes
Automatic "knowledge drift" detection with generated draft updates
AI/agent-powered search across docs and connected tools
Team verification/approval workflow with audit trail
Analytics on what team members read and search for

alternatives.name: Slab
alternatives.description: A knowledge management wiki emphasizing fast search and clean organization for company-wide knowledge sharing.
alternatives.best_for: Non-technical to tech-savvy teams wanting a simple, well-organized company wiki.

alternatives.name: Document360
alternatives.description: An AI-powered knowledge base for internal and external/customer-facing documentation.
alternatives.best_for: Support and technical writing teams needing both internal KB and public docs with analytics.
